properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign and validate JWT access tokens.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: JWT access token lifetime in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated frontend origins allowed by CORS.

properties.name: parking.booking.early-checkin-minutes
properties.description: Number of minutes before the booking start time when check-in becomes available.

properties.name: parking.booking.no-show-grace-minutes
properties.description: Grace period in minutes after booking start before an unattended booking is treated as a no-show.

properties.name: parking.booking.extension-reminder-minutes
properties.description: Number of minutes before booking end when the extension reminder becomes applicable.

properties.name: parking.booking.extension-grace-minutes
properties.description: Grace period in minutes after booking end during which an extension may still be requested.

properties.name: app.default-admin.name
properties.description: Display name used when initializing the default administrator.

properties.name: app.default-admin.email
properties.description: Email used when initializing or reconciling the default administrator.

properties.name: app.default-admin.password
properties.description: Initial password encoded with BCrypt for the default administrator.
